English:
ZenArchieve is a high-performance, modern archive manager engineered specifically for Windows 11 and Windows 10. Built with native C# and WPF, it delivers a sleek Fluent interface with Mica glass styling, replacing outdated legacy compression utilities.

Key Highlights:
- Multi-Format Support: Seamlessly compress and extract ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, GZ, BZ2, XZ, and ISO formats.
- Pinned Topmost Extraction: Password prompts and extraction progress windows stay locked on top so they never slip behind background windows.
- One-Click In-Place OTA Updates: Automatically updates in the background without requiring manual uninstallation.
- In-Archive Duplicate Inspector: Scans inside compressed archives using SHA-256 hash sets to identify duplicate files and reclaim wasted space without unpacking.
- Archive Merge & Deduplication: Combine two separate archives into a single unified archive with intelligent conflict resolution.
- Isolated Safe Previews: Preview images and text documents directly inside archives without extracting them to disk. Suspicious executables are automatically shielded.
- High-Speed Hardware Compression: Multi-threaded LZMA2 engine optimized for modern multi-core processors.
- 100% Free & Open Source: No trial expiration popups, no bundleware, and zero advertisements.

Version 2.1.1 Release:
- Official Microsoft Store & SourceForge integration.
- Rating & review prompt with persistent dismissal preference.
- Ultra-compact package optimizations (~6.3 MB MSIX / 6.7 MB EXE).
- Direct Windows 11 context menu verbs and 7-Zip acceleration.
Windows 11 native Fluent design with Mica backdrop
High-speed multi-threaded LZMA2 compression and decompression
Supports ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, GZ, XZ, ISO, and CAB archives
Pinned topmost extraction windows and password dialogs
Merge two archives with automatic deduplication
Built-in safe image and text file previewer
Zero trial expiration nag screens or advertisements
High-performance modern Windows 11 archive manager with Fluent Mica design, in-place OTA updates, and duplicate file detection.
